shared_elements: monolithic upright stone block as the carved support
carving in low/medium relief on a vertical face
motifs stacked in vertical registers, one above another
curvilinear, rounded raised forms against a flat ground
a creature-like figure rendered in relief
justification: Both are upright stone monuments carved in relief with motifs stacked in vertical registers down the face, and both use rounded, swelling raised forms rather than incised line alone. Beyond that generic correspondence they diverge sharply: A is a dark, heavily weathered anthropomorphic block covered in shallow abstract/emblematic devices including a prominent disc and horizontal bands, while B is a pale, sharply cut rectangular pillar bearing a single high-relief quadruped above a flatter splayed animal, with no discs, bands or human form.
